GEM HOUSES BARCELONA is renting this commercial space with a fully operational supermarket.

It comprises 70m² (49m² usable space) divided into two areas: an open-plan shop and a warehouse with a cold storage room and a bathroom.

Renovated with an alarm system, heating, and air conditioning.
